description: Return a list of AMPscript function names, keywords, and variable names available at a given position in the code. Set target to 'next' to filter completions to only MCN-supported functions.

character.description: Zero-based character offset within the line.

line.description: Zero-based line number of the cursor position.

target.description: Target platform. Use 'next' to return only completions supported in Marketing Cloud Next.

name: get_ampscript_completions
